info.longName: Capital Group Ultra Short Income ETF

funds_data.description: The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in bonds and other debt securities that accrue income, which may be represented by derivatives. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest primarily in investment grade, U.S. dollar denominated short-term debt, including: high-quality, short-term money market instruments such as commercial paper and certificates of deposit; U.S. treasury securities and other government securities guaranteed or issued by an agency or instrumentality of the U.S. government; corporate securities.
